escena: SCENE (a premium product photograph in a closed studio, as for a design-object catalogue): a single free-standing door panel of thick ACID-ETCHED FROSTED GLASS, its edges polished and slightly green-clear, stands upright on a seamless studio sweep painted a deep saturated blue-navy, the brand blue of the whole picture,, seen straight on and slightly from below, the panel square to the camera and filling the lower-middle of the frame. Mounted vertically on the glass, right of centre, is a long round PULL BAR in satin teal-anodised aluminium, the exact teal of the brand, on two short polished standoffs: an object that unmistakably invites you to grab it and pull. A tall strip softbox standing just outside the frame on the left is the source: it throws one long crisp specular stripe down the teal bar and a hard clean edge of light along the left side of the glass, while a low backlight behind the panel makes the frosted glass glow from within, deep navy at its edges rising to a soft cool cyan near the centre. To the LEFT of the bar, at mid height, the frosted glass is clean, smooth and empty for a hand's width, with no sticker, no sign, no letters, no symbols and no marks. No hands, no people. The whole frame is cool and contemporary: nothing is warm, amber, orange or golden. The top edge of the door panel sits well below the middle of the frame; above it, the upper third of the picture is the seamless ink-navy backdrop, one smooth unbroken field of deep navy with no light, no gradient band and no bright spot in it. 100mm macro-capable lens at f/8, every edge of the object tack-sharp.

texto.muro: the seamless ink-navy studio backdrop above the door panel

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the seamless navy studio sweep running under the lens
lecho.tono: DARK matte ink-navy paper in deep shadow, its fine fibre barely visible
